sourceNote: Hand-constructed: there is no Module:Junctions/data. Scraped 2026-08-31 through a real browser (wiki.warframe.com is behind a Cloudflare JS interstitial; curl/api.php return a challenge page). Reflects the Update 39 'Isleweaver' Junction Rework plus the Update 40 change of the Venus Junction's first task from Vor's Prize to The Teacher. 13 junctions, 4 tasks each. NOTES: (1) `id` is the wiki `InternalName` from Module:Missions/data, which is what joins to `Missions[].Tag` in the account dump. It follows the <From>To<To>Junction pattern EXCEPT for the Jupiter Junction, whose tag is still the legacy `CeresToJupiterJunction` even though the junction now sits on Deimos - do not regenerate that id from from/to. (2) Junctions do NOT appear in DE's ExportRegions_en.json (269 nodes, none of type junction), so the wiki is the only source for both ids and tasks. (3) The wiki tables include a final 'Complete the Junction' row; that is the junction clear itself (and carries the completion rewards), not a prerequisite, so it is omitted here - DE's own patch notes list exactly 4 'Junction Tasks' per junction. (4) Uranus Junction task 3 uses the current in-game wording documented in the Update 42 patch notes ('...in one mission'); the Uranus_Junction page body is stale and omits that clause. (5) Certain star chart paths have no junction at all and are therefore absent: all paths to the Void, Earth -> Lua, and Mars -> Deimos. (6) Rewards are deliberately not captured. Task refs are normalised to the canonical quest name in quests.json (the in-game wording 'The Rising Tide' refers to the quest titled 'Rising Tide'); the original wording is preserved in `text`.
